steps.text: All 3 tests pass now. The fix updates `parse_duration` to use a regex that finds all `(\d+)([hms])` components in the string, sums up their contributions in seconds, and raises `ValueError` if there's any leftover text that isn't a valid duration component. This handles combinations like `'1h30m'` (5400 seconds) as well as the existing `'45s'` and `'2h'` cases.
